title: Revised packaging
passage:
Why was the packaging specification revised?
A. The revision is in the shared folder. B. The customer requested recyclable materials. C. Twenty cartons fit on a pallet.
passageZh:
為什麼修訂包裝規格？
A. 修訂版在共用資料夾裡。
B. 客戶要求使用可回收材料。
C. 一個棧板可放二十個紙箱。
